proposal.reason: Main change is adding a full independent TROCE GIN backend (new host/device GIN implementation, plugin registration, GIN type/device-type wiring, context/memory registration/progress logic). Also needs network review because shared IB transport/provider plumbing is changed (provider detection/classification in net_ib init/common and shared IB GDR/property helper behavior), which can affect broader network transport behavior beyond the new backend.
